 Borussia Dortmund vs. Werder Bremen Lineups, Live Streaming, How & Where to Watch DFB-Pokal on TV
 Originally posted on
 Athlon Sports 
  | 
 By Pragjyoti Singh
  | 
 Last updated Oct 27, 2026 1:45 PM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 Borussia Dortmund hosts Werder Bremen in the DFB-Pokal today at Signal Iduna Park.
 The matchup promises plenty of excitement following their Bundesliga meeting on October 9, when Werder Bremen fought back from a two-goal deficit to secure a 2-2 draw with a stoppage-time equalizer.
 Dortmund currently sits level with Bayern Munich at the top of the Bundesliga standings, with both teams on 17 points. Niko Kovac’s side enters the match after consecutive wins, including a 1-0 victory over Eintracht Frankfurt.
 The Black and Yellow remain unbeaten in the league this season, securing five wins and two draws in their opening seven matches.
 Meanwhile, Daniel Thioune’s Werder Bremen sits sixth in the standings with 12 points and heads into the cup clash after a 3-2 victory over Mainz last weekend.
 Robin Koch challenges Serhou Guirassy during the Bundesliga match between Borussia Dortmund and Eintracht Frankfurt.Leon Kügeler / Getty Images
 Despite that win, Werder Bremen will be wary of Dortmund’s performances at home this season. Dortmund has recorded three wins and one draw in four home matches, collecting 10 points out of a possible 12.
 That run includes a 3-0 clean-sheet victory over SC Paderborn and a 2-0 win against Hamburger SV. With home-field advantage and an unbeaten league record behind them, Dortmund will look to carry that momentum into the DFB-Pokal.
 Dortmund vs. Werder Bremen Lineups
 Borussia Dortmund predicted lineup: 
 Ostrzinski; Gadou, Anton, Ritter; Ryerson, Bellingham, Chukwuemeka, Svensson; Nwaneri, Beier; Albert
 Werder Bremen predicted lineup: 
 Hein; Arthur, Schmetgens, Pieper, Deman; Regeer, Lynen; Weiser, Chuki, Grüll; Fullkrug
 How & Where to Watch Dortmund vs. Werder Bremen
 Soccer fans in the United States can watch the DFB-Pokal match exclusively online through ESPN+. Kickoff is scheduled for 3:45 p.m. EDT.
